headline: Control Automate covers on your local network
intro: Connect a Rollease Acmeda Automate Pulse Hub v1 to Home Assistant to monitor and control covers, with a sensor for battery condition. The integration communicates directly with hubs on your local network.
highlights: Add an Automate Pulse Hub v1; multiple hubs are handled through discovery
Monitor and control covers, and check battery condition through a sensor
Cover position and tilt are unsupported; use Home Assistant for room and scene functionality

flow.title: From Automate hub to cover controls
stages: Connect an Automate Pulse Hub v1 on the local network
Set up the hub through discovery in Home Assistant
Monitor and control covers and check battery condition
